context:
Goal: mockups are drawn to the phone you carry on mail day.
Problem (goal): no record or Apple page in this repo gives the phone size, designers drew four different sizes, and only you know which phone you use.
Based on (read): designers drew 375, 402 by 874, 430 by 900 and 440 by 956 points; the repo's measured runs use an iPhone 17 or iPhone 18 Pro simulator.
Departs from: main records no phone size for mockups — this records one.
Waiting on: your answer; designers keep drawing at their own sizes until then. All the design-churn mockups are on the design-churn branch for review and culling.
home: repo record for mockup sizes (to be filed)

options.gain: Matches the iPhone 17 simulator the repo already measures on.
options.how: Mockups are drawn at 402 by 874 points.
options.label: 402 by 874 points
options.lose: A larger or smaller phone shows differently.

options.how: Mockups are drawn at 440 by 956 points.
options.label: 440 by 956 points
options.lose: Rows look roomier than on a smaller phone.

options.how: Mockups are drawn at 375 points wide.
options.label: 375 points wide
options.lose: Looks cramped next to a current phone.

title: Which phone size should every mockup be drawn at?
why: One recorded size stops designers drawing four different phones; other sizes are checked separately.
